content: Akanksha Bhatt followed up regarding her health policy coverage for OPD consultations and MRI scans. Insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh confirmed policy coverage, detailed the applicable co-pay (₹500 per OPD visit) and deductible (₹2,000 annual deductible with a 10% MRI cost share), and provided the required pre-authorization form along with submission instructions.

action_items: Fill out the attached Pre-Authorization Form
Submit the completed form to the hospital via email or fax at 1800-555-0199
